<!-- pr-reviewer: baf5a1c5ff1218efd5d6df5a45ba7fa34a3cd27c -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good:
- The panic text in `the capability test` now names the hole-order kinds (Drill, Bore, Thread) and the sinker kinds (Sinker Burn, Sinker Side Burn), as issue #4110 asks. No assertion text changed.
- The `Bore` fixture entry (`Entry3D::Plunge`) added in the second hunk is now identical to what current `main` already carries, so the merge keeps a single copy.
- Follow-up commit `baf5a1c5f` carries `Fixes #4110` in its body, and the PR body ends with `Fixes #4110` on the last line. This answers the change request of the earlier collaborator review (`1cd28a35f`).
- No production code, UI, posted G-code, safety check, geometry, stock simulation, dependency, script, golden, or snapshot changes.

Results (built locally, no self-hosted runner: the author is not a collaborator):
- Trial merge with `origin/main`: clean (no conflicts). The `hole_order.rs` entry-line hunk in the PR is identical to `main` and collapses into one copy.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: PASS (2 steps)
  - `app start_exit_shared (1 fn)`: ok in 302s (`every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick`)
  - `app start_exit_shared (hole_order::)`: ok in 3s
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test start_exit_shared`: PASS - 40 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS
- `cargo xtask gate light` (11 light twins, release): PASS - 6 steps ok (release build 229s, motion light lib 397s, adaptive_troch_island 45s, adaptive_troch_neck 16s, adaptive_troch_parallel 10s, app pocket_pass_start 3s)

Targeted tests: the `start_exit_shared` suites named by the quick plan (one fn + the `hole_order::` submodule) and the full `start_exit_shared` binary. No toolpath or post change, so no example catalog suites. No heavy lane: this is a test-text fix on a `P7` issue, not a safety-floor change. No heavy record consulted.

Requested before merge: none.

Questions / notes (not blocking):
- The panic text still does not name the 5-axis kinds (Contour5D, Parallel5D) and the PlasmaProfile kind that the match also handles (#3330, #3334). The issue asked only for the hole-order and sinker additions, so this is fine as-is; a follow-up could name those too. Pre-existing in the old text as well.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
